title: feat(spec+showcase): add 'tree' view type + business_unit org-chart example
body:
## What

Adds a **`tree` view type** to the `@objectstack/spec` ListView schema and exercises it in the showcase with a self-referencing `business_unit` org chart.

This is the metadata/data half of the tree-grid feature; the renderer lives in objectui ([plugin-tree](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/_)). Pairs with objectui#1885.

## Why

Self-referencing, **arbitrary-depth** hierarchies (org charts, category trees, BOMs, nested comments) can't be expressed by fixed-depth `grouping`. A tree view nests records by a single-parent pointer field. ObjectStack's `tree`/lookup self-reference is unambiguous (unlike Airtable's many-to-many links), so the nesting is well-defined.

## Changes

**Spec** (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`)
- `'tree'` added to `VisualizationTypeSchema` and the `ListView.type` enum.
- New `TreeConfigSchema` (`parentField` / `labelField` / `fields` / `defaultExpandedDepth`, passthrough) + `tree` key on `ListViewSchema`. Without this the runtime Zod-validates view metadata and silently drops `type:'tree'`.

**Showcase** (`examples/app-showcase`)
- New `showcase_business_unit` object (self-referencing `parent` lookup).
- 3-level org-chart seed (company → division → department → team).
- `BusinessUnitViews`: grid + an `Organization Chart` tree view, wired into nav + config.

## Verification

Ran the showcase backend with this branch and confirmed `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_business_unit.org_chart` serves `type:"tree"` with the full `tree` block intact and `_diagnostics.valid:true`; the objectui console renders the indented tree-grid with working expand/collapse over the seeded hierarchy.
